evidence: Configures clang-tidy in `src/.clang-tidy`, which falls under linter and static analysis configuration in test infrastructure.
rationale: Enables thirteen clang-tidy bugprone checks to prevent subtle bugs across the codebase, while fixing a minor test-only string literal truncation bug in `util_tests`. As noted by the author, 'Apart from a test-only bug, they didn't find anything severe, but I think it still makes sense to enable them'.
